dispatched.note: An app whose own code picks the tool: a classifier answers {"intent":"order"}, the code calls query_order() itself and hands its answer to a second chain with its own system prompt. No tool is named on the wire. The person typed a password into the message. Only the wrapped function's call and return are tool evidence: no row carries the password, and nothing in tools has an empty name. search_faq is never called and records nothing; REFUND_POLICY is not a function and is said once in the log. The router's own file names query_order too, as a read can; the call is recorded once, under the function's own name.
